text: This code is a straightforward and efficient implementation of the task. It uses a while loop to iterate over the input list in reverse order, appending each element to a new list. The loop starts at the last index of the list and decrements the index until it reaches the first element. This approach ensures that the input list remains unmodified, as required. The resulting list is then returned, containing the elements of the original list in reverse order. This solution is simple, easy to understand, and has a time complexity of O(n), making it suitable for large input lists.
